pairs.difference: A: magnifier floats on a green concentric-ring field with a soft lighter centre, nothing else on the card. B: hoop floats on a cyan ring field, cut by the right and bottom edges, net is its own part. Both are clean category-1 fields with quiet tone-on-tone rings, and both background numbers sit inside the real range.

A: snorkel mask lies on dock planks with water behind, and the top-left corner adds a wooden post wrapped in coiled rope. The snorkel subject doesn't call for those, and the corner gets busy for no reason. B: caravan on a strip of grass in front of a quiet purple ring field, no extra objects.
pairs.fix: Snorkel and mask lying on plain wooden dock boards with calm water behind; no posts, no rope, nothing else on the dock.

pairs.difference: A: racket lies on a green court with one white line, and the ball is its one partner object. B: a clear bag holding a ring lies flat on green stitched leather that fills the card. B's high detail number most likely comes from the see-through bag leaking into the background mask, not from clutter. Both surfaces are quiet.

A is a redraw of the real ship-wheel card. Its rays are more saturated purple-pink, the plank floor has drawn crack and grain lines, and it ends in a dark curved horizon edge. The real card has a plain, soft-lit floor and paler rays. B: water-polo goal sits right where it is used, close up and cut by the card edges, in a pool with a few large calm shapes.
pairs.fix: Plain light wooden floor with soft, barely visible board seams and no cracks or grain lines; pale, soft rays behind the wheel.

pairs.difference: A: coat on a wall hook, plus a window with a skyline, a potted plant and a dresser drawer filling the left edge. These are invented room props the subject never names. B: viewer stands right where it is used, close and cut by the card edge, with only a railing and the city behind it.
pairs.fix: Coat hanging on a hook against a plain warm wall, seen close; no window, no plant, no furniture.

pairs.difference: A: camera floats on a soft blue diamond pattern, tone-on-tone like the real juice card. B: player and earbuds float on purple rings, and the earbuds are a fair partner object. Neither backdrop competes with the hero or adds props.
A: fan on yellow wavy bands. B: hat on purple wavy bands. Both use the same quiet wave field as the real sunscreen card, with no added props.
A: safe on a plain pink seamless floor. B: vending machine on a plain purple seamless floor with a faint glow at its base. Both are clean category-2 staging.

B: a map lies on wood planks with a large magnifying glass placed on top. That second hero-sized object is an invented extra, it covers the centre and pushes edge density to the top of the range. A: badge wallet alone on the planks, flat and seen from above.
pairs.fix: Folded map lying flat on wooden boards, seen from above, nothing resting on it.

pairs.difference: A: handcuffs lie on a plain red gradient with no pattern. B: sneakers stand on a pale yellow floor against an orange wall with a crisp horizon, like the real juice card. Both backdrops are very quiet, and nothing is added in either.

pattern: Generated cards over-dress the staging: they add props the subject never names (rope-wrapped dock posts, a window with a plant and a dresser, a magnifier on a map, islands and life rings around a lighthouse). They also pull back to show the whole object on a base instead of cropping close, and they put drawn grain, crack lines or a glow halo into floors and backdrops that are plain on the real cards.
